states.meaning: Stand comfortably in place with arms relaxed, gentle breathing and a small friendly head tilt. Both feet stay planted. No walking, jumping or exaggerated gestures.

Stand in place crafting a small imaginary object between both hands at belly height. Look down, cup the left hand, and use precise short right-hand shaping movements, then raise the hands slightly to inspect the result. Keep feet planted.
A joyful small celebration in place: bend knees slightly, straighten proudly, lift both forearms in a small victory gesture, nod happily, then settle back. Keep feet on the ground and do not spin.

Stand focused in place and inspect an imaginary handheld workpiece. Hold it near the belly with the left hand, lean the head closer, make two deliberate right-hand adjustments, pause to check, then relax. No walking.
